title: RubriX: A Fast, Fine-Tunable Non-Autoregressive Rubric Judge
abstract: arXiv:2610.34875v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubric-based evaluation asks which level of a rubric a response meets. It is usually done by prompting a large language model (LLM) as a judge, which needs a generative call per judgment and reads every level description, so its cost grows with the rubric. We present RubriX, a rubric judge whose architecture is inspired by contrastive language models (CLM): a LoRA-adapted encoder embeds the input and each level description, and a softmax over scaled cosine similarities gives a probability for every level without text generation. Trained on public rubric data and proprietary synthetic data, RubriX reaches 75.4% exact accuracy on held-out rubrics, against 57.1% for TypeSafe's Jev and 49.8% for a Qwen3-8B judge. On eight human-labelled benchmark sets it is within 6 percentage points of Jev's accuracy on most of them, while Jev keeps a larger lead on two and ranks responses best on average; against the results reported in the G-Eval paper, R

translated_title: RubriX：一种快速、可微调的非自回归量规评判器
translated_abstract: 基于量规的评估是判断某个回答符合量规中的哪一个等级。这通常通过提示大型语言模型（LLM）作为评判者来完成，每次判断都需要一次生成式调用，并且需要读取所有等级的描述，因此其成本会随着量规规模的增大而增长。我们提出了RubriX，一个架构受对比语言模型（CLM）启发的量规评判器：一个经过LoRA适配的编码器对输入和每个等级描述进行嵌入表示，再对缩放后的余弦相似度做softmax运算，无需文本生成即可给出每个等级的概率。在公开量规数据和专有合成数据上训练后，RubriX在留出量规上达到75.4%的精确准确率，而TypeSafe的Jev为57.1%，Qwen3-8B评判器为49.8%。在八个人工标注的基准数据集上，它在大多数数据集上的准确率与Jev相差在6个百分点以内，而Jev在其中两个数据集上保持更大领先优势，且在响应平均排名上表现最佳；与G-Eval论文中报告的结果相比……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: RubriX是一种受对比语言模型启发、利用LoRA适配编码器和余弦相似度softmax的非自回归量规评判器，无需文本生成即可高效判断回答符合量规哪个等级，准确率达75.4%，显著超越现有LLM评判方法。
en_tdlr: RubriX is a fast, fine-tunable non-autoregressive rubric judge inspired by contrastive language models, which uses a LoRA-adapted encoder and softmax over scaled cosine similarities to classify rubric levels without text generation, achieving 75.4% accuracy and outperforming existing LLM-based judges.
